body: Mason: from #77's merge comment, the design port's leftovers, once Noble's walk-through notes are in (npm run -s notebook): the follow-ups listed at the end of docs/dispatch/14-comp-report-design-port.md (one edited draft per length, Hubert's Fix-both chip reaching Send, setting an agent to practice in Access, Escape dropping a half-filled comp form, step 1's address retitling the report, Mark as sent recording the copied tab, the pixel polish), plus whatever Kimani's dev notes from the walk-through add.
